verdict.rationale: Make supports centralized Connections (credentials) per team, retrievable via API, and has an entity ACL endpoint to manage which principals have a role on a connection, indicating some access control over shared credentials. However, there is no evidence of team-wide credential sharing workflows, granular per-user/role permission UI, or documentation describing governance policies for who can use which credential beyond the raw ACL API. missing for 10: user-facing docs on sharing/permission UI for connections, role-based credential usage controls beyond API-level ACL, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this workflow.
